ingredients.evidence: EU SCCS Opinion on Hydrogen Peroxide in Oral Hygiene Products (2011); US EPA Safer Choice Chemical Criteria for Oxidants; OECD SIDS Initial Assessment Report for Hydrogen Peroxide
ingredients.note: Safe green alternative to harsh chlorine bleach in household sanitization.

ingredients.name: Coco-Glucoside
ingredients.concern: Extremely low irritation potential; suitable for sensitive and infant skin. Rare contact dermatitis reported only in highly sensitized individuals.
ingredients.evidence: CIR Final Report on Alkyl Glucosides (2013); EU SCCS Opinion on Cosmetic Ingestion Tolerability (2017); ECHA REACH Dossier EC 604-232-9
ingredients.note: Derived from coconut oil and fruit sugars; non-stripping cleansing agent.

ingredients.name: Citric Acid
ingredients.function: pH Adjuster, Chelating Agent & Natural Alpha Hydroxy Acid
ingredients.concern: Mild transient ocular or dermal stinging at high unbuffered acidic concentrations. Generally recognized as safe (GRAS) with benign physiological clearance via Krebs cycle.
ingredients.evidence: US FDA 21 CFR §184.1033 (GRAS Status); CIR Safety Assessment of Citric Acid & Inorganic Citrates; Joint FAO/WHO Expert Committee on Food Additives (JECFA)
ingredients.note: Used extensively to balance formula pH between 4.5 and 5.5.

ingredients.name: Sodium Carbonate (Washing Soda)
ingredients.function: Water Softener, Builder & Alkaline pH Buffer
ingredients.concern: Moderate eye irritant in concentrated powder form. Natural mineral with low ecological impact and minimal dermal toxicity.
ingredients.evidence: OECD SIDS Screening Information Data Set for Sodium Carbonate; US EPA Safer Choice Ingredient List; ECHA EC 207-838-8 REACH Dossier
ingredients.note: Precipitates calcium and magnesium ions in hard wash water.

ingredients.name: Linear Alkylbenzene Sulfonate (LAS)
ingredients.concern: Can cause significant hand skin dryness and irritant dermatitis if handled without gloves. Toxic to aquatic organisms with long lasting effects in unmanaged wastewater.
ingredients.evidence: HERA (Human and Environmental Risk Assessment on ingredients of household cleaning products) LAS Risk Assessment; ECHA Registration Dossier EC 246-680-4; US EPA High Production Volume (HPV) Chemical Challenge Report
ingredients.note: Primary active surfactant in conventional laundry detergents and dish soaps.

ingredients.name: Synthetic Fragrance (Parfum)
ingredients.concern: Contains undisclosed mixtures of synthetic aromatics and stabilizing fixatives. Leading cause of allergic contact dermatitis in cosmetic products according to clinical patch tests. May contain undisclosed phthalate plasticizers (e.g. DEP) in non-regulated formulations.
ingredients.evidence: EU Scientific Committee on Consumer Safety (SCCS/1459/11) Fragrance Allergens; International Fragrance Association (IFRA) Standards 50th Amendment; American Academy of Dermatology (AAD) Contact Dermatitis Monograph
ingredients.note: Found in both leave-on and rinse-off personal care and household items.

ingredients.name: Sodium Lauryl Sulfate (SLS)
ingredients.concern: Known primary skin and ocular irritant at concentrations above 1-2%. Can disrupt epidermal lipid barrier causing transepidermal water loss (TEWL). Implicated in recurring aphthous ulcers (canker sores) when used in dentifrices.
ingredients.evidence: Cosmetic Ingredient Review (CIR) Safety Assessment of SLS (2005); European Chemicals Agency (ECHA) Registration Dossier EC 205-788-1; World Health Organization (WHO) International Chemical Safety Card 0502
ingredients.note: Widely utilized in rinse-off cleansing formulations; contact duration usually under 2 minutes.

ingredients.name: Phenoxyethanol
ingredients.concern: Potential dermal irritant in individuals with eczema or damaged skin barriers. Strictly restricted to a maximum 1.0% concentration in cosmetics under EU Regulation (EC) No 1223/2009. Not recommended around infant mouth areas due to potential nervous system depression if ingested.
ingredients.evidence: EU SCCS Opinion on Phenoxyethanol (SCCS/1575/16); CIR Safety Assessment of Phenoxyethanol (2011); French ANSM Safety Evaluation of Phenoxyethanol in Pediatric Formulations
ingredients.note: Effective against Gram-negative bacteria in water-based cosmetics.
